name: Setup Wizard writes the collective at full stick on the Rotorflight type only
step: Check the Setup Wizard's collective gate by rates type
rationale:
The Pitch step's collective at full stick is degrees on the Rotorflight rates type
(12.5 degrees per 100 of rcRates_4). On the Actual type the same byte is scaled differently,
so the wizard must not write it there; the harness pins which rates types the gate allows.
